{"effort": "high", "extra": {}, "max_tokens": 8000, "messages": [["user", "## Scenario

Emergency department visits and wait times at three metro hospitals, Jan-Jun 2024

The county health department compiled per-visit records from three hospitals for January through June 2024 to assess a new triage diversion policy.

## Columns

| Column | Kind | Declared as |
|---|---|---|
| `cost` | measure | unit USD; additive |
| `day_of_week` | category | Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri, Sat, Sun; ordered=ordinal; derived from visit_date; group calendar |
| `hospital` | category | Mercy General, St. Luke's, Riverside; group entity |
| `is_weekend` | category | No, Yes; ordered=ordinal; derived from visit_date; group calendar |
| `month` | category | 2024-01, 2024-02, 2024-03, 2024-04, 2024-05, 2024-06; ordered=ordinal; derived from visit_date; group calendar |
| `quarter` | category | 2024-Q1, 2024-Q2; ordered=ordinal; derived from visit_date; group calendar |
| `satisfaction` | measure | unit points; non-additive |
| `severity` | category | Minor, Moderate, Severe; ordered=ordinal; group triage |
| `visit_date` | time | 2024-01-01 to 2024-06-30, daily; group calendar |
| `wait_minutes` | measure | unit minutes; additive |

## Figures

- `f01`
    p0: bar, grouped by hospital, AVG(wait_minutes), unit minutes
    p0 reads hospital off the axis tick
    drawn to answer: Which hospital and department waits longest
- `f02`
    p0: line, grouped by visit_date, AVG(wait_minutes), unit minutes
    p0 reads visit_date off the axis tick
    drawn to answer: How wait time moved over the half year
- `f03`
    p0: scatter, grouped by nothing, NONE(wait_minutes, satisfaction), unit minutes, points
    drawn to answer: Do longer waits go with lower satisfaction
- `f04`
    p0: bar, grouped by hospital, AVG(wait_minutes), unit minutes
    p0 reads hospital off the axis tick
    p1: pie, grouped by hospital, AVG(wait_minutes), unit minutes
    p1 reads hospital off the legend
    the panels are related by: part_whole
- `f05`
    p0-p2 each: grouped_bar, grouped by hospital, quarter, AVG(wait_minutes), unit minutes
    p0-p2 each reads hospital off the axis tick, quarter off the legend
    p0 is titled 'Minor'
    p1 is titled 'Moderate'
    p2 is titled 'Severe'
    the panels are related by: small_multiples

    p0: bar, grouped by hospital, AVG(wait_minutes), unit minutes

    p0 reads hospital off the axis tick
    the panels are related by: overlay_range
- `f08`
    p0: bar, grouped by hospital, AVG(wait_minutes), unit minutes, labelled 'AVG(wait_minutes) [minutes]'
    p0 reads hospital off the axis tick
    p0: category_line, grouped by hospital, SUM(cost), unit USD, labelled 'SUM(cost) [USD]'
    p0 reads hospital off the axis tick
    the panels are related by: overlay_metric
- `f09`
    p0: bar, grouped by hospital, AVG(wait_minutes), unit minutes, labelled '2024-01-01 to 2024-03-31'
    p0 reads hospital off the axis tick
    p0: category_line, grouped by hospital, AVG(wait_minutes), unit minutes, labelled '2024-04-01 to 2024-06-30'
    p0 reads hospital off the axis tick
    the panels are related by: overlay_slice
- `f10`
    p0: bar, grouped by hospital, AVG(wait_minutes), unit minutes
    p0 reads hospital off the axis tick
    the panels are related by: part_whole
- `f11`
    p0: pie, grouped by hospital, AVG(wait_minutes), unit minutes
    p0 reads hospital off the legend
    the panels are related by: part_whole
- `f12`
    p0: table_chart, grouped by is_weekend, severity, AVG(cost), unit USD
    p0 reads is_weekend off the inline label, severity off the inline label
- `f13`
    p0: grouped_bar, grouped by is_weekend, severity, MAX(cost), unit USD
    p0 reads is_weekend off the axis tick, severity off the legend
- `f14`
    p0: area, grouped by visit_date, severity, MIN(wait_minutes), unit minutes
    p0 reads visit_date off the axis tick, severity off the legend
- `f15`
    p0: stacked_bar, grouped by quarter, month, AVG(wait_minutes), unit minutes
    p0 reads quarter off the axis tick, month off the legend
- `f16`
    p0: heatmap, grouped by hospital, day_of_week, COUNT(*)
    p0 reads hospital off the axis tick, day_of_week off the axis tick
